title: Unstable castle panoroma & splash text
description: Changes the menu panorama to the Unstable spawn from the Unstable SMP
body:
The Unstable smp spawn is a build on the Unstable SMP built by Horacealtman. This resource pack turns the menu panorama into the Unstable smp spawn.

I used the map from Unstable Leaks - Discord server to make this panorama and also it has a splash text saying (This kingdom isn't yours)
